title: Augmented increasing-tuple sheaf complex with affine section comparison
statement: Let $A,B$ be commutative rings, $X$ a scheme, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ separated, $g:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$, and $p:X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}B\to X$ the projection [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $U:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$ be a finite affine open cover, including $r=0$, and $G$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. Suppose the tensor pullback $p^*$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is additive. There exist a nonnegative cochain complex $C$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and $\epsilon:G[0]\to C$ such that: (1) $f_*(\operatorname{extend}C)$ is isomorphic as an integer cochain complex to the explicit affine alternating section model [def-pc-affine-alternating-cech-model]; (2) $\epsilon$ and $p^*(\operatorname{extend}\epsilon)$ are quasi-isomorphisms; (3) for every $k\in\mathbb N$ there are $n\in\mathbb N$ and affine opens $W_j\subseteq X$, $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(n)$, such that $C^k\cong\prod_j (W_j\hookrightarrow X)_*(G|_{W_j})$. The empty product is permitted. No derived functor or derived-unit assertion is included.

proof.text: Form actual sheaves P(W)=j_W*(G restricted to W), with P(W)(V)=G(V intersection W). Restriction along W contained in Z gives P(Z)->P(W), compatible with the O_X(V)-action. In degree k take the product over increasing (k+1)-tuples, with intersections W_t, and signed face restriction differential as in the section complex. Pair the two orders of deleting two entries: restrictions agree and their signs are opposite, proving d squared zero. The restriction maps G->P(U_i) have zero composite with d, giving epsilon.

On U_i, evaluate a cochain at the tuple obtained by inserting i, sorted with sign; use zero for a repeated index. Each term is over the same intersection after restriction to U_i. In dh+hd, deleting the newly inserted i gives the original cochain, while deleting another index cancels between the two summands. This also contracts degree zero against the augmentation. Thus epsilon is locally a homotopy equivalence and is a quasi-isomorphism. Restriction of tensor pullback to p inverse U_i commutes with restriction of modules. Apply the additive tensor pullback to the same homotopy identities: it preserves sums, negatives, compositions and identities, so the pulled-back augmentation is again locally a homotopy equivalence. Extension by zero preserves both conclusions. No flatness or general preservation of quasi-isomorphisms by tensor is asserted.

Nonempty finite intersections of the U_i are affine because f is separated over an affine base. Enumerate the finite increasing-tuple type by Fin n, and reindex its product; n=0 covers degrees without tuples. Pushforward is a right adjoint and preserves these products. For each affine intersection W_t, the quasi-coherent direct image on Spec A is the tilde of Gamma(W_t,G), with its A-action through f. The tilde-Gamma counit and its naturality intertwine each restriction map. The tilde functor is additive and preserves finite biproducts. Hence the product comparisons intertwine the signed differential and assemble into the complex isomorphism with affineAlternatingCechModel. Negative degrees are zero. If r=0, the cover condition makes X empty and all module sheaves are zero.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affineAlternatingCech_augmented_construction {A B : CommRingCat.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec A) [IsSeparated f] (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec A) {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤) (haffine : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).Additive] (G : X.Modules) [SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.{u} G] : ∃ (C : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ) (ε : (CochainComplex.single₀ X.Modules).obj G ⟶ C), Nonempty (((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (C.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat) ≅ affineAlternatingCechModel f U G) ∧ QuasiIso ε ∧ QuasiIso (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (HomologicalComplex.extendMap ε ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)) ∧ ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ (n : ℕ) (W : Fin n → X.Opens), (∀ j, IsAffineOpen (W j)) ∧ Nonempty (C.X k ≅ ∏ᶜ fun j : Fin n ↦ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (W j).ι).obj (G.restrict (W j).ι))
